text:
noah: quick report from onboarding: client 'Atelier' LoRA merge onto atelier-7b then int4 quant introduces inconsistent currency formatting in the canonicalization eval. putting notes here.

rachel: can you paste the minimal failing outputs?

noah: examples from the smoke pack: input "Please normalize: $1,200.00" -> expected "$1,200.00". after merged+int4 we got variants: "1200", "1.2k", and sometimes "$1200" (missing decimals). downstream parser expects two decimals and fails on the shorthand.

omar: sounds like token boundary + rounding changes. did you run tokenmap diff and decode-check?

noah: ran tokenmap-diff on prompt prefix; small shifts at punctuation tokens. snippet: "token-ids before: [45,67,89,11] after: [45,67,186,11]". also ran decode-sanity and saw top-5 candidates differ on the decimal punctuation token.

sujay: what qprofile used for int4? any per-channel scaling or clipping tweaks?

noah: used standard nf4-v2 profile: "group=128,clip=0.995,percdamp=0.01". merge command: `merge_lora --base atelier-7b --lora client/atelier-lora.safetensors --out mrg.safetensors`.

omar: try two quick isolations: 1) export merged as int8 with per-channel scale, 2) re-merge with `--preserve-ln` to avoid touching layernorm stats.

noah: ran both. repro command used: ```python -m ri_eval.run --model mrg.safetensors --quant int4 --eval-pack ateliersmoke.json --limit 250``` ci-bot kicked off job eval-1779345000-atelier-smoke.

ci-bot: job started: eval-1779345000-atelier-smoke (ETA ~3m).

noah: results summary: pre-merge int4 baseline amt_fmt_exact 0.97; merged+int4 0.70; merged+int8 0.95. re-merge with --preserve-ln + int4 -> 0.88. changing group to 1024 bumped to 0.93.

rachel: ok so int4 amplifies tiny merge deltas; preserving LN helps and larger group reduces quant noise. good signal.

omar: agree. next try: tune clip to 0.999 and re-run quickpack to see if clipping was truncating punctuation tokens. also run the KV-cache alignment test to make sure long-prefix generation doesn't shift tokenization.

sujay: for customer-facing recommendation: default their route to merged-int8 on Dedicated. propose a canary to route 5% traffic to int4 once we publish an int4 profile that passes the currency-smoke checklist. add a note in KB referencing the evalpack id and seed.

noah: filing KB: evalpack_id atelier-smoke-1779345000 seed=1234. reproducer for preserve-ln test: ```python -m ri_eval.run --model mrg_preserveln.safetensors --quant int4 --group 1024 --clip 0.999 --eval-pack ateliersmoke.json --seed 1234```

rachel: also add a small unit test to ri_eval that checks currency canonicalization exact-match in top-3 logits. that'll catch regressions in CI.

omar: one more thing try re-ordering LoRA application if client supplied multiple adapters. we've observed order-dependence when LoRAs touch scale/bias in residual branches. run a 3-way reorder smoke (A+B, B+A) and diff.

noah: queued reorder runs. documented next steps: 1) finish clip/group tuning, 2) run reorder test, 3) if we can reach >=0.95 on int4 with preserve-ln+group 1024+clip 0.999 then update int4 profile and schedule a 10% canary. otherwise default to int8 for customer. I'll attach eval JSON when runs finish. :white_check_mark:
